reason: Expand 416 native WCVP plant climatic niches to a globally regular 0.5-degree grid, apply authoritative PMIP4 reconstructed 0 and 21 ka physical land & grounded ice masks, and compare potential climate-suitable topology for accepted host groups of 513 insects. Never assert actual ancient plant occupancy or genetic barriers.

grid.climate: Nearest neighbor sample from 8 SHA-bound CHELSA-TraCE21K original rasters; sample EPSG:4326, no off-grid extrapolation at raster edges.
grid.PMIP4_coarsen: Each global 0.5 degree cell corresponds to exactly 3x3 original 10-arcmin reconstructed ICE6GC source cells; transform 0..360 to -180..180 with source original longitude seam.
grid.physical_mask_main: >=5 of 9 ten-minute original subcells must be ice-free land (`sftlf=100 AND sftgif=0`); this is a coarse mean-value terrain accessibility proxy, not a perfect cell shoreline.
grid.area: sum spherical equal-angle 0.5-degree latitude-dependent cell areas

model.training_predeclared: source-only WCVP-native GBIF observations 10km thin cap200, >=30 plant and native-region pseudo-background, original fixed 4 variables bio01,bio07,bio12,bio15
model.model: Original quadratic 4-var degree2, L2 logistic C=0.3, liblinear, balanced classes, deterministic tol1e-5, solver reproduction must match original all 416 x6337 source saved 0BP predictions within max absolute tolerance 1e-5 and source threshold within1e-5; fail closed, never retune.
model.standardization: original global present reference 6343 finite points determines same mean and sd for both epochs
model.threshold_main: 10th percentile fitted modern native plant presence scores, source-fixed exactly
model.climate_nonanalog: A projection is flagged if any of 4 standardized variables lies >0.05*(native presence+background training range) beyond that range; no-data flagged separately.
model.main_analog_rule: Reject nonanalog CLIMATE CELLS in BOTH epochs for graph topology. Secondary report climate extrapolation included to assess coverage-dependent bias.
model.spatial_passability: Suitable plant climate AND authoritative 0BP/21ka terrain ice-free land AND climate nonanalog rule
model.connectivity_main: 4-neighbor on 360x720 regular grid with periodic dateline boundary; connected components only among continuously adjacent potentially suitable cells.
model.connectivity_sensitivity: 8-neighbor permissive diagonal corner jumps; report as sensitivity not true dispersal behavior
model.species_host_rule: For each insect, OR all 1-3 recorded WCVP host-plant potential suitable pixels; only score if models for ALL recorded hosts available; retain remaining 83 partial and 45 none as unscored, no data imputation.

outputs: all518 plant climate+terrain component statistics for 0BP and21ka
all641 insect climatic host habitat component statistics including statuses
number climate suitable cells, mask suitable land km², number of components, and % suitable cells in largest component, time differences
sensitivity outputs for thresholds and land mask all/any and 8-neighbor
preserve source-hashed reproduction check summary for 416 old SDM scores and 6337 points
prohibitions: This is potential climatically suitable traversable substrate, not actual occupied plant ranges at 21ka
No inference of per-species historical dispersal distance, pollinator host fidelity, genetic effects or genuine host-resource corridors
No selective dropping species with negative results
No result-driven tuning of the grid resolution, land fraction threshold, climate projection, novel-climate range or neighborness
No opening of previously frozen TTF LGM genetic responses. TTF true-host-vs-other-plant v0.5 negative outcome remains unchanged.
